name: Russia
description: Follow Russia, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Daily fragment: Aeroflot Flight 821
changes.summary: Aeroflot Flight 821, a Boeing 737-500, crashes into a section of the Trans-Siberian Railway while on approach to Perm International Airport, in Perm, Russia, killing all 88 people on board.

changes.title: Lithuania prepares for war, reinforcing its border against Russian tanks
changes.summary: On the edge of NATO territory in the Baltics, there is growing concern about the threat Russia poses. Aaron MacLean visited the capital of Lithuania to see how they're preparing.

changes.title: Trump says Ukraine needs to stop targeting Russian refineries
changes.summary: Civilians were killed and injured overnight into Sunday as both Russia and Ukraine kept up large-scale drone strikes.

changes.title: Trump calls on Ukraine to halt strikes on Russian diesel fuel, saying attacks are causing a shortage
changes.summary: Ukraine has for months been targeting Russia's oil and gas industry with long-range strikes, prompting fuel rationing across the country and causing Moscow to ban diesel exports in July, one factor disrupting the global supply of diesel.

changes.title: Trump Wants Ukraine to Stop Striking Russian Refineries. What Would That Mean for the War?
changes.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump attends the Irish Open at the Trump International Golf Links & Hotel in Doonbeg, Co Clare, during his trip to the Republic of Ireland on Sept. 13, 2026. —Liam McBurney—PA Images President Donald Trump called on Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to halt strikes on Russia's diesel fuel i.

changes.title: As Russia Again Draws Near, a Frontline City Fears Obliteration This Time
changes.summary: The Ukrainian city of Izium still bears the scars of Russian occupation from four years ago. As Moscow’s forces approach, residents are bracing for the worst.

changes.title: Why Emerging Powers Keep Joining BRICS, Even When They Disagree
changes.summary: The leaders of China, Russia, India, Iran and other nations in the BRICS club gather in New Delhi this weekend, but wars and soaring energy prices divide them.

changes.title: Zelenskyy visits Canada to seek more military support for Ukraine against Russia
changes.summary: Ukraine is under mounting pressure from Russia's intensifying air campaign that uses ballistic missiles and jet-powered drones to pierce defenses. Moscow's attacks have targeted Ukraine's power grid ahead of winter in what officials say is part of its campaign to demoralize civilians.

changes.title: Putin tells Trump that Russia doesn't have aggressive intentions toward Europe, Kremlin says
changes.summary: The war could yet drag on for years as Russia reconstitutes its forces and its defense industry, said U.S. Undersecretary of Defense Elbridge Colby.

changes.title: Lithuanian civilians, including children, training for possible Russian attacks
changes.summary: Lithuania is preparing citizens in case the Russia-Ukraine war spreads to their country. CBS News national security analyst Aaron MacLean has the latest.
